source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相欲翻，静压欲破
title: 真相欲翻，静压欲破
purpose: 承接 SC35：表面秩序只剩最后一线。此段继续按节点拆开：先是科沙度的结论几乎逼近公开事实，再是十四郎的怒线逼近真正破裂，接着拓拔野在近乎见底的状态下继续硬撑，最后把白衣女子那股将翻未翻的静压推进到只差最后一瞬就会破开的边缘。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕或任何可读文本。

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, accusation, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
